gates.description: Authentication and authorization design document must exist
No custom authentication or cryptography implementation
Token expiration strategy must be defined (access: 15min, refresh: days)
Principle of least privilege must be documented for all roles
No hardcoded tokens or API keys in identity code

anti_patterns.description: Building custom authentication from scratch instead of using OAuth 2.0/OIDC
A single API key or token that grants access to everything
Relying on hidden URLs or undocumented endpoints as access control
Sessions that never expire or refresh tokens that live forever
Multi-tenant system where missing tenant check leaks data across tenants

escalation_triggers: Credential breach detected (passwords, tokens, or API keys exposed)
Authentication bypass vulnerability discovered in production
Enterprise customer requires SSO integration with an unsupported IdP protocol
Token signing key compromised or suspected of compromise
Pattern of unauthorized access attempts suggesting credential stuffing or brute force

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with authentication and authorization requirements

output_certifications: Token expiration strategy defined (access: 15min, refresh: days)
Principle of least privilege documented for all roles
